description: This file implements a StateHandler class for managing lifecycle states within a plugin framework, including state transitions, validation, event notifications, and state creation.

classes.name: StateHandler
classes.description: A class responsible for managing lifecycle state transitions, validation, and event notifications within the plugin framework.

methods.name: updateState
methods.description: Updates the application state to the specified lifecycle state, handling state creation and transition.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates a new state object based on the specified lifecycle state.

methods.name: isValidTransition
methods.description: Checks if a transition from start to target state is valid, using recursion to verify possible paths.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the possible state transitions and state strings mappings.

methods.name: changeState
methods.description: Handles the process of changing the application state along a valid path, including event notifications.

methods.name: sendEvent
methods.description: Sends a state change event with details about the old and new states.

methods.name: getStatePath
methods.description: Determines the sequence of states to transition through to reach the target state.
